title: Which cards Hometax will and will not register
alt: Hometax business credit card registration page listing eligible and ineligible card types and the credit information consent
note: The eligibility list as the National Tax Service words it. Accepted: credit cards and check cards in the name of the representative or the company, and rechargeable prepaid cards converted to a registered name — gift cards only. Refused: family cards, gift cards, rechargeable prepaid cards, 직불카드 and department store cards. Note that a check card is accepted while 직불카드 is not; English guides that translate both as 'debit card' get this backwards. The screen also asks that a freight driver welfare card be kept out, and states that a card registered this month can be checked for an identity match from around the 10th of next month.
redaction: Browser chrome cropped away. Nothing on the page itself was masked — no business registration number or trade name had been selected.
